organization.description:
**As of August 2025, this page is no longer actively maintained or updated. Sorry for any inconvenience caused. For the latest disaster alerts please visit: https://adam.geospatial.wfp.org/live**

WFP's corporate geospatial solution for emergency preparedness, early warning & response.

Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies. Currently operational for floods, earthquakes and tropical storms, ADAM issues alerts and response dashboards aggregating relevant, evidence-based, near-real time risk and impact information. More WFP data can be found here: https://data.humdata.org/organization/wfp
